Punjab Police SI Training at PPA Phillaur: A Day Inside

Quick answer

A day of Punjab Police Sub Inspector training at the Phillaur academy: PT, weapons, 17 indoor subjects, parade, games, swimming and horse riding.

Many aspirants ask me what happens after selection. This is what my training routine at the Punjab Police Academy, Phillaur looked like when I spoke on the podcast. Our batch was appointed the year before and the training period was one year.

Two programmes

The day is divided into an outdoor programme and an indoor programme, from early morning to evening.

A typical day

Time (approx.)What happens
Early morningPT period in track suit
After PT30-minute break to bathe, change into uniform and tie the turban
MorningWeapons lecture: handling and knowledge of different weapons
Mid-morning1.5-hour break for food and rest
Late morning to afternoonIndoor classes
Afternoon2-hour break
Late afternoonParade lecture and parade practice
EveningGames period: any sport you like

What is taught indoors

There are almost 17 subjects. Some of them:

  • Investigation
  • BNS and BNSS, the new criminal laws
  • Forensic medicine and science
  • Security

Extra skills

Two or three times a week there are also swimming lectures, and we are taught horse riding. These are skills most of us never had a chance to learn before.

What I learned from it

Getting the uniform needs hard work, and wearing it properly needs the same hard work. What I value most is the fixed schedule. When you follow a proper routine for a year, many good habits come by themselves. The academy gives you a platform to improve yourself physically and mentally.

For aspirants

  • Fitness does not stop after the physical test. Training is physical every single day. Read How I Stayed Fit While Studying.
  • Law and reasoning matter later too. The indoor subjects build on what you studied for the exam.
  • Discipline is the real training. If you build a routine during preparation, training feels natural. See Discipline and Consistency.

Also read: Punjab Police SI Preparation Strategy

Shared from my own experience. Details of training can change from batch to batch.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

Where does Punjab Police SI training happen?

My batch trained at the Punjab Police Academy, Phillaur. The training period for our batch was one year.

What is taught in Punjab Police SI training?

There is an outdoor programme (PT, weapons, parade, games) and an indoor programme with around 17 subjects, including investigation, the new criminal laws BNS and BNSS, forensic medicine and security.
